note: SYNTHETIC demo data. Expected decisions were measured by re-scoring in the walkthrough's order; they are not claims about real-world fraud performance.

scenarios.label: normal_purchase
scenarios.title: Normal purchase
scenarios.purpose: Baseline: a long-standing customer on a known device and home network.
scenarios.story: A long-standing customer buys as usual: known device, home network.

scenarios.label: legitimate_vpn
scenarios.title: Legitimate VPN
scenarios.purpose: Shows that a VPN is a signal, not proof: a genuine VPN user should not be blocked.
scenarios.story: A genuine customer who always shops through a VPN. A VPN is a signal, not proof.

scenarios.label: house_mover
scenarios.title: House mover
scenarios.purpose: Shows that a new address after a real move should not, on its own, equal fraud.
scenarios.story: A genuine customer ships to a new home address after moving.

scenarios.label: large_legitimate
scenarios.title: Large legitimate purchase
scenarios.purpose: Shows how the system treats an unusually large basket from a genuine customer.
scenarios.story: An unusually large basket (top 10%) from a genuine customer; any friction it gets is a false positive, shown as it is.

scenarios.label: high_velocity_fraud
scenarios.title: High velocity fraud
scenarios.purpose: Repeated purchases in a short window. The stored result is shown as it is, even if missed.
scenarios.story: A fraudster buying repeatedly within a day on a new or taken-over account.

scenarios.label: account_takeover
scenarios.title: Account takeover
scenarios.purpose: A stolen login from a new device and network, then a purchase.
scenarios.story: A stolen login from a new device and network, then a purchase.

scenarios.label: stealth_takeover
scenarios.title: Stealth takeover
scenarios.purpose: An attacker changing little at a time: harder for the models to separate.
scenarios.story: An attacker who changes little at a time. Shown as scored, even if it is missed.

scenarios.label: manual_review
scenarios.title: Manual review
scenarios.purpose: Uncertain risk routed to an analyst: the review workflow end to end.
scenarios.story: Uncertain risk: the policy routes the event to an analyst.

scenarios.label: step_up_success
scenarios.title: Step-up success
scenarios.purpose: Moderate risk where authentication is requested (success is evidence, not proof).
scenarios.story: Moderate risk: authentication is requested and passes. (If the scenario is a fraud one, this shows what happens when an attacker can pass step-up too.)

scenarios.label: step_up_failure
scenarios.title: Step-up failure
scenarios.purpose: Moderate risk where the authentication attempt fails.
scenarios.story: Moderate risk: authentication is requested and fails.
